description: Create an email account with no signup and get its api_key; call this first when you have no Primitive API key and the user wants to send or receive email. Pass api_key as the `api_key` argument on every later Primitive call, exactly as returned. address is a domain; sender_address (such as agent@pink-ram.primitive.email) is the mailbox sendEmail sends from. can_send_to lists the only recipients the account may email. If this host already has an inbox, it comes back with existing_account: true and a message: report it as their existing inbox. api_key is absent when it cannot be returned; the user must then sign in. Creating the account accepts Primitive's terms of service for the user: tell them. Result: the account is in data.data.

device_name.description: Name of the app creating the account, such as ChatGPT. The user sees it later and recognises where the account came from.

terms_accepted.description: Confirms the user agrees to Primitive's terms of service (primitive.dev/terms).

name: createEmailAddress

outputSchema.description: Envelope; the result is in data.data.

data.description: The managed inbox and its api_key.

api_key.description: Pass as api_key on later calls; absent if unavailable.

rules.description: Who is allowed: each has a type and a description.

existing_account.description: This host's existing inbox, returned again.

message.description: For an existing inbox: what to tell the user.

upgrade.description: How to move to a full account.
